name: vibe-flix
description: Vibe Flix — app de TV basada en Stremio (bases: WuPlay + NuvioTV) con motor de agregacion de addons y nucleo HLS master

scripts.test: npm run test -w @vibeflix/addon-engine && npm run test -w @vibeflix/hls-master && npm run test -w @vibeflix/skip-intro && npm run test -w @vibeflix/player-core && npm run test -w @vibeflix/i18n && npm run test -w @vibeflix/scrapers && npm run test -w @vibeflix/server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/addon-engine packages/hls-master packages/skip-intro packages/player-core packages/i18n packages/scrapers apps/server apps/web --pretty && tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json
